reviews.author: Karen Burke
reviews.text: A beautiful experience from start to finish. The room was lovel, warm and very comfortable with everything at hand. The food was outstanding, as was the wine (we ate in the bar).  Staff are excellent.  They're a credit to themselves and the Senior Management in The Grace.  We're really looking forward to going again soon! reviews.author: O7626AQmadeleinem

reviews.author: pierreaZ5182PI
reviews.title: Not what we expected...
reviews.text:
We had heard about the recent opening of The Grace and booked 2 nights during our September road trip across Ireland. From the dreamy imagery and enticing descriptions on the website, I was imagining a luxury boutique accommodation set in an idyllic oasis of nature.

Reality was unfortunately very different and it is beyond me how The Grace is listed as member of the exclusive Small Luxury Hotel collection.

From the exterior, The Grace has the charm of an airport hotel, a large building entirely surrounded by a parking lot. Once inside, the experience is definitely more refined and elegant, however it's very dark, as there is very little natural sunlight.

We had booked one of the Clew Bay suites and the room was large, well equipped and tastefully decorated. However, when you open the curtains, the large windows offer no other view than… the parking lot! reviews.author: danielmF2690EQ
reviews.title: Best hotel around Westport
reviews.text:
The Grace Hotel is hands down the best hotel I've stayed in around Ireland. The staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming from the moment you arrive.

The housekeeping team are probably the best I've encountered at any hotel — genuinely attentive. They even come round in the evening to turn down the bed and leave a pillow spray to help you sleep. Little touches like that make a real difference.

The breakfast buffet is also up there as the best I've had anywhere. I didn't manage to get into the Black Sheep restaurant as it was fully booked, so I'd definitely recommend booking that in advance if you're visiting. That said, the food in Kelly's Bar was excellent and a bit easier to grab a table.

The location is great too — a short walk into Westport, but far enough that you can skip driving in and dealing with the traffic.

All in all, a fantastic stay and I'd highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Eymard Brennan
reviews.text: Have no words to describe our stay in the Grace is was just amazing,one of the best if not the best hotel we have ever stayed in.A warm welcome staff could not be more helpful,food was fantastic  and the breakfast just something else.5 stars all the way highly recommended you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: johnsF2265EC
reviews.title: September break
reviews.text: We spent 5 nights at the Grace,commencing on 6th September. The staff and food were excellent.However we did not get off to an auspicious start.After a 4/5 hour drive we arrived at 3.15 pm. We were told that our room was not ready, understandable as check in is not until 4pm. However despite several requests we did not get in to our room until 5.30pm.Reception or the member of staff who helped with our luggage could not provide an explanation for the long delay. We did receive an apology at the time,but it is slightly disappointing that we had to pay for our cup of coffee whilst we endured the long wait.It would have been a nice gesture to have had a complimentary coffee.

reviews.author: tinacB3849OI
reviews.title: 5 Stars
reviews.text: Back from a fabulous evening in Kelly's Bar food, atmosphere   and service excellent. Staff so friendly  & efficient  particularly Carlos and Lexi just brilliant.   The hotel  decor, furnishings  and attention to detail -  Superb.  Well done  everyone

reviews.author: B1638CNlauram
reviews.title: We Can’t Wait to Come Back.
reviews.text:
We had the best time staying at The Grace Westport! From the moment we checked in to the moment we checked out, everything - and every person was just fantastic.

A special shout-out to Mary, who made us feel so welcome and went above and beyond to make our stay so enjoyable. Breakfast was absolutely fantastic too!

We would fully recommend The Grace and can’t wait to return. We had such a lovely stay! ❤️

reviews.author: clairedL2792GG
reviews.title: Top class
reviews.text: We finished off our trip to Ireland in Westport and stayed at The Grace. What a perfect way to end our trip! Beautiful hotel, great atmosphere and wonderful staff. A special mention to Ciaran, whose pride in the hotel really shows and made us feel so welcome. We loved Westport and couldn’t have picked a better place to finish an unforgettable trip to Ireland.

reviews.author: Amy Arduini
reviews.text: On the lovely, lush, green Isle Of Ire. I had the pleasure of staying with friends to witness the Union of Brianne and Chris.  With an amazing vibrant floral grounds, beautiful scenery and doting staff members. Shout out to all the staff who tended our wedding,  but especially Adrian and Svetlana. Also the bar tender who's name I unfortunately did not catch.  Who never let us go without hydration and quickly tended to our every reasonable request throughout the night.  Would 100% recommend this hotel to my American family and friends if they ever visit Ireland. Can't speak higher of my experience.

reviews.author: D6332QAgeraldines
reviews.title: A wonderful experience from morning to night!
reviews.text: We stayed at The Grace from August 23rd through the 26th. What a wonderful stay we had! The rooms were clean, comfortable and had everything we needed! We enjoyed the great food from  our Sunday dinner in the comfort of the cozy Kelly’s bar to our special night at The Black Sheep! The service on Monday night at The Black Sheep was great from Emma who helped us choose a wine and to David who couldn’t do enough for us! The food was excellent ( we especially loved our scallops and the pork belly appetizers!!). We also enjoyed a night cap at the lovely cocktail bar. We can’t talk about food without mentioning the best breakfast we have had on our travels which has included Ireland, Italy and Switzerland! The sausage rolls were a favorite as was the Irish Brown Soda Bread!!! Breda who was doing hostess duty was professional, friendly and working hard to seat everyone in a timely manner on a busy morning! reviews.author: Claire Jackson
reviews.text:
As a non resident visited the Grace for breakfast this morning. It was to.mark a special birthday so the budget stretched to 26 euro per person
The staff were helpful, friendly and numerous. The buffet was extensive and continuously replenished and the provision of gluten friendly options was unusually impressive

reviews.author: Faye Cusack
reviews.text: We had the most amazing stay at the Grace. We stayed for a birthday celebration and the staff could not have been more brilliant. We will definitely be back

reviews.author: Emily O Reilly
reviews.text:
A fabulous experience. From the moment we walked in the door. My partner and I  really could not get over how friendly and attentive the staff were. The room was immaculate and the dining was superb. The buffet breakfast was well controlled, constantly restocked, clean and fresh. They had lots of fancy homemade pasteries like almond croissants, cinnamon swirls, apple strudels etc that I thought was a really lovely touch. The pool area was very clean with no wet floors so it was nice to walk around - it was evident the cleaners were also there regularly as even the public showers and surrounding was very clean and tidy.
Another thing we loved beyond the perfect location of the hotel, was the live music in the evening and the very knowledgeable (& friendly) mixtoglist working behind the bar - so plenty of entertainment in the evening!

We loved it so much, we booked to stay again at the check out (which we have never done before)!

A shoutout to chef Martin for the fabulous meal and birt
